tool_input.content:
version: 2
models:
  - name: can_account_value
    description: "Canonical account value table. One row per financial account enriched with client demographics and primary advisor details. Joins resolved account, client, and advisor entities through the client-account and client-advisor bridges."
    config:
      domain: 'Account'
    columns:
      - name: account_value_id
        description: "Surrogate key for this canonical row"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: financial_account_id
        description: "FSC financial account identifier (natural key)"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: account_number
        description: "Custodian-assigned account number"
      - name: account_name
        description: "Resolved account display name (FSC > Custodian)"
      - name: registration_type
        description: "Legal registration: Individual, Joint, Trust, Custodial"
      - name: account_type
        description: "Account type: Brokerage, IRA, 401k, Trust, etc."
      - name: status
        description: "Resolved account status across all source systems"
      - name: custodian_code
        description: "Resolved custodian: SCHW, PERS, or FIDL"
      - name: inception_date
        description: "Resolved account open date"
      - name: market_value
        description: "Resolved total market value (Performance > FSC balance)"
      - name: fee_rate
        description: "Management fee rate from FSC"
      - name: fee_schedule
        description: "Fee schedule tier from Performance system"
      - name: model_id
        description: "Resolved model portfolio assignment"
      - name: is_discretionary
        description: "Whether the account has discretionary authority"
      - name: client_id
        description: "FSC account ID representing the client (household/individual)"
      - name: client_name
        description: "Resolved client full name"
      - name: client_segment
        description: "Client segment: HNW, UHNW, Mass Affluent, Institutional"
      - name: service_model
        description: "Service model tier assigned to the client"
      - name: risk_tolerance
        description: "Client risk tolerance profile"
      - name: advisor_id
        description: "Primary advisor FSC identifier"
      - name: advisor_name
        description: "Resolved advisor full name"
      - name: advisor_rep_code
        description: "Resolved advisor rep code"
      - name: advisor_team
        description: "Advisor team name"
      - name: advisor_region
        description: "Advisor team region"
      - name: account_match_status
        description: "Cross-system match quality: ALL_MATCHED, FSC_PERF, FSC_CUST, FSC_ONLY"
